name: Engine selection
responsibility: Lays one measured graph out the way its root options name
description: Nothing outside this seam knows which nesting drew. A solve asks for its nesting and its answer carries the drawing, both in the root options. Track fixes its nesting as inline or groups, and Blocks as blocks. A Blocks graph that takes a dense placement is solved in parts (ADR 0078). The Graphviz engine that stood here beside them is gone (ADR 0040).
